evidence: local Pearl GPU source, py-pearl-mining host adapter, operand-vector-001, and PHK1 raw BSCAN protocol

stages.name: PearlHash noise/search candidate generation
stages.input_bytes: job key + search parameters; exact host serialization is implementation-defined in existing miner
stages.output_type: noised A/B matrices and winning tile coordinates/commitment material
stages.output_bytes: depends on m,n,k and proof configuration; no universal fixed size
stages.verification: official PearlHash CPU proof verifier and vector commitments

stages.name: PearlHash selected operand tile
stages.input_type: four A lanes and eight selected B lanes per record, int8
stages.input_bytes: 24576 operand bytes plus 28-byte PHK1 header and 4-byte CRC = 24608 request bytes per tile
stages.output_bytes: 64 raw bytes plus 28-byte PHKR header and 4-byte CRC = 96 response bytes per tile
stages.verification: raw-to-canonical identity comparison then CPU PearlHash reference verification

stages.name: host canonical composition
stages.input_type: PHK1 raw uint32 words and job/tile identity
stages.output_bytes: depends on canonical composition; no fixed byte count proven
stages.verification: canonical result equality, job fingerprint/generation match, reference verifier

stages.name: proof construction and verification
stages.input_type: selected work plus commitment roots and PRL header
stages.input_bytes: proof-dependent; no fixed input byte count
